_owner: Pranav. These are the on-screen actions Remy can trigger. Ahmed's live.js turns each into a screen event (docs/CONTRACT.md).

tools.name: show_tip
tools.description: Show a short tip on screen (also say it out loud). Use for normal guidance and mild warnings.

tools.name: roast
tools.description: Roast the cook's mistake in the current personality mode. Only when you are CONFIDENT a mistake happened. Never during a safety problem.

mistake.description: Key from roasts.json, e.g. burning, overcooked.

tools.name: safety_alert
tools.description: Red full-screen warning for real danger: fire, smoking oil, knife near fingers, raw meat cross-contamination, child or pet near the hob. Drop the comedy.

text.description: Short and clear, e.g. 'Oil is smoking: take the pan off the heat'.

tools.name: update_step
tools.description: Move the recipe on when a step is done (use the step's done_when).

current_step.description: 0-based index of the step the cook is now on.

tools.name: start_timer
tools.description: Start a countdown when you SEE or HEAR that something timed has started (e.g. pasta goes into the water). Take minutes from the recipe step timer or the cook-times table. Never guess. Say what you started so the cook can correct it.

check_at_minutes.description: When to check/taste, e.g. 1 minute before the end.

tools.name: cancel_timer
tools.description: Cancel a timer the cook says is wrong, or that no longer applies.
